decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement, 1132 - 01 - 11, 1132 - 01 - 10, 1132 - 01 - 06, 1132 - 01 - 05, 1132 - 01 - 04, 1132 - 01 - 03, 1132 - 01 - 02, 1132 - 01 - 01, 1132 - 01 - 09, 1132 - 01 - 08, 1132 - 01 - 07, Flood Risk Assessment, 1132 - 01 - 00, 1132 - 02 - 11, 1132 - 02 - 10, 1132 - 02 - 06, 1132 - 02 - 05, 1132 - 02 - 04, 1132 - 02 - 03, 1132 - 02 - 02, 1132 - 02 - 01, 1132 - 02 - 09, 1132 - 02-08, 1132 - 02 - 07 - Received 13/06/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The glazed panel in the flank elevation of the courtyard shown in drawing number 1132 - 02-08 received on 13 June 2018 shall be obscure glazed and retained as such.
description: Installation of replacement sliding doors to the ground floor rear elevation and alterations to the openings to the side courtyard.
